description: Create an empty portfolio (and the account it sits in) in the user's household, e.g. one per bank or broker. Records structure only; nothing is bought or sold. Modification Plan flow: call without confirm to get a plan, show plan.human_message to the user, and only if they approve call again with confirm=true and plan_id. Plans expire after 5 minutes.
